title: Monomorphisms toward disjoint unions of dimension zero rings are exactly those with weakly decent point fibres

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Quotient groupoid over a field
standard_prerequisites.use: When the quotient over a field is a field spectrum.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): a monomorphism toward a disjoint union of dimension zero local rings has fibre over each point a quotient of a point by a transitive relation; the when-field lemma identifies each fibre with a field spectrum.

(2) implies (1): weak decency of the point fibres makes each fibre a field spectrum; the map is injective on points over each base point and induces isomorphisms on residue fields, hence a monomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Transitive-relation fibres; residue-field identification; monomorphism recognition.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction characterization anchored on the carded when-field lemma.
